_ghi_chu_16_08: Claude va Anthropic da duoc loai khoi cau noi runtime.
SEEKER khong con dung LLM de boc tai lieu trong mot_luot.
Chi bat OpenAI khi da khai bao model ro rang, schema dau ra, gioi han chi phi
va co lap noi dung web khong tin cay khoi quyen cong cu/he thong tep.

_huong_dan_bat.claude: dat bien moi truong ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, dien model_anthropic (vd claude-sonnet-4-5), doi duong=anthropic
_huong_dan_bat.deepseek: dat OPENAI_API_KEY=<khoa deepseek>, OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com, dien model_openai=deepseek-chat, doi duong=openai
_huong_dan_bat.tran: tran_moi_ngay=40 va cach_nhau_giay=600 la phanh chi phi - khong sua khi chua tinh lai tien

_ghi_chu_01_09: Bat qua cc-switch: khoa+base_url+model doc TAI CHO tu ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db,
khong chep sang day. Doi khoa trong cc-switch la doi luon o day.
Phanh chi phi: 40 luot/ngay, cach nhau 600s. Muon tat: doi duong=tat.
_ghi_chu_04_09: temperature=0: viec cua duong nay la TRICH XUAT co cau truc, khong phai hoi thoai.
Truoc 04/09 khong dat -> deepseek-chat chay o 1.0, sinh loi dinh dang phai di va.
json_mode=true: bat response_format json_object khi nguoi goi dung hoi_json.
Tat json_mode neu doi sang mot API tuong thich-OpenAI khong nhan response_format.
